title: Forward process in closed form
goal:
Implement the variance schedule and the closed-form forward process (Section 2, Equations 2 and 4).

`make_schedule(T, beta_1=1e-4, beta_T=0.02)` returns `betas`, `alphas`, and `alpha_bars` as arrays of length `T`. The betas increase linearly (Section 4), $\alpha_t = 1 - \beta_t$, and $\bar\alpha_t = \prod_{s=1}^t \alpha_s$.

`q_sample(x0, t, eps, alpha_bars)` returns $x_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,\epsilon$. The timestep `t` follows the paper and starts at 1: `t=1` reads `alpha_bars[0]`. `t` is an integer or an integer array with one entry per row of `x0`.
hints: Array index `t - 1` holds the value for paper timestep `t`. Reading `alpha_bars[t]` is off by one, and at `t = T` it raises an error.
For a vector `t`, gather with `alpha_bars[t - 1]`, then reshape to `(-1, 1, ...)` so that it broadcasts against `x0` of shape `(batch, dim)`.
